candidates.requirement: The existing CBOR round-trip equality assertion must hold for CBOR inputs accepted by from_cbor.
candidates.target_route: Input bytes 0xf9 0x7e 0x00 decode as half-precision NaN. Float construction preserves NaN; to_cbor emits it as a double; the second from_cbor returns NaN; the entry compares the two values.
candidates.failure_condition: The float equality branch uses floating-point ==, so j1 == j2 is false and the existing assertion fails.
candidates.alternative_paths: The entry always performs the comparison after successful parsing and serialization. Its catches handle exceptions, not a failed assertion; equality does not use dump or normalize NaN.
